name: Haha Sange
source:
Koga Tomonori is an ordinary college student and the only son of a typical middle-class family. A year and a half after losing his biological mother to an incurable illness, his father remarried a beautiful stepmother, Hanae, and together with her daughter, Marie, they’ve been living a relatively happy life. 

But one day, Tomonori discovers a shocking truth: his father, Seiichi, had been cheating on his late wife for years — and the other woman was none other than his current stepmother.

Tomonori had always resented his father, blaming him for his mother’s death. He believed her illness worsened because his father neglected the family. Yet he’d also tried to convince himself this resentment was misplaced — that his father must have grieved too. But he was wrong.

“Dad had been deceiving Mom the whole time she was sick.”

In terms of betrayal, his stepmother was just as guilty. After his mother’s death, she’d stepped into the role of the picture-perfect wife and mother, acting like nothing was wrong. All of it was a facade.

“I’ll take everything from Dad! Starting with stealing his beloved wife — and I’ll make sure he sees it!”

His feelings for his stepmother twisted into something dark, sparking a spiral of revenge and humiliation. Even as he knew this path would destroy their family — a point of no return — he kept going.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc2/pcl005/hahasange.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
古贺友则是一名普通大学生，也是典型中产家庭的独子。亲生母亲因不治之症去世一年半后，父亲迎娶了美丽的花江。此后，他与继母及她的女儿玛丽相对幸福地共同生活。

然而一天，友则发现一个震撼真相：父亲诚一多年来一直背叛亡妻，而婚外情对象正是现在的继母。

友则一直怨恨父亲，把母亲的死归咎于他。他认为母亲病情恶化，是因为父亲忽视家庭，却也曾努力说服自己这种怨恨并不公平，父亲想必同样经历了悲痛。可事实证明，他错了。

“母亲患病期间，爸爸一直在欺骗她。”

继母同样背负着背叛之罪。母亲去世后，她扮演起完美妻子与母亲，仿佛一切都没有问题，可这一切都只是伪装。

“我要夺走爸爸的一切！首先就从抢走他深爱的妻子开始——而且我要让他亲眼看见！”

他对继母的感情扭曲为黑暗之物，引发一场复仇与羞辱的漩涡。即使明知这条道路会毁灭家庭、再也无法回头，他依然继续前进。

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc2/pcl005/hahasange.html]官方网站[/url]]
